summary: -1008 is documented as an HTTP 503 variant, not a 400 body code; the SDK drops every 5xx body, so the SYSTEM_THROTTLED category cannot occur and the test models the wrong transport.
expected: The documented -1008 answer reaches the SYSTEM_THROTTLED category built for it.
actual: A 503 raises ServerError(status_code=503) with no body code; classify applies the class rule first and returns STATUS_UNKNOWN (retry-eligible on a cancel/query).
impact: Small: a placement is ambiguous in both cases (probe, then ENTRY_STATE_UNKNOWN + SAFE_MODE). The record and the test describe a behaviour the real transport cannot produce; a documented 100% failure of an entry costs a SAFE_MODE episode.
evidence: BINANCE.md:110 'A body code -1008 under a 400 is SYSTEM_THROTTLED'; tests/test_system_throttle_protection.py:70-77 raises BadRequestError(..., -1008); official general-info: 'HTTP 503 return code is used when: ... 4. ... (-1008)'; binance_common/utils.py:500-503 raises ServerError(status_code=status) for 5xx; exchange_errors.py:779 class rules before the table.
why_tests_miss: The fake SDK raises BadRequestError, the same assumed HTTP class as the code.
recommendation: Correct BINANCE.md 6.2 and the table note; make the test raise ServerError(503); decide with the owner whether a 5xx may be told apart at all.

category: protection model / exchange fact behind a decision
summary: D079 places the stop only after the fill; its stated premise (-4509) covers only the closePosition variant, the project's own Demo probe showed a pre-placed reduce-only stop works, and no reason for rejecting that alternative is recorded.
expected: A decision that leaves a filled position without an exchange-side stop records why the feasible alternative was not taken, and the summary states the exchange fact correctly.
actual: The stop exists only after the running process sees the fill. If the process, host or network is down when the resting GTD entry fills, the position has no stop on the exchange until restart; with the process alive up to max_unprotected_ms = 180 s is allowed.
impact: Unprotected position for an unbounded time when the process is not running. Example: 0.004 BTC at 80,000, planned risk 4.8 USDT; a 6% move while offline loses about 19.2 USDT with no stop.
evidence: AGENTS.md:112 'Demo rejects a conditional stop with no position, -4509'; 18-probe-check.txt:37-40 'pre-placed explicit-quantity reduce-only STOP_MARKET while flat: accepted (status NEW, quantity 0.0008)', orphan cancelled cleanly, quantity equals position; 19-NOTES.md:16 'the Demo showed it accepted and sized equal to the position [DEMO], but it is not built'; DECISIONS D079 'Model (b) is not built'; change-log 2025-11-06 'GTE_GTC orders ... depend ... on positions only'.
reproduction: Reasoning from the cited texts; not probed.
why_tests_miss: Tests and the Demo smoke run with the process alive; 'process absent at fill time' is not tested against exchange-side state.
recommendation: Owner decision: record why model (b) is rejected, or add a pre-placed reduce-only stop as an exchange-side backstop; correct AGENTS.md:112.

summary: Documented definitive refusals that are not in the code table (-4131, -4118, -2023, -2025, -4045, ...) and the documented 100%-failure 503 variants are treated as an unknown outcome; for the emergency close this freezes the single close attempt as UNKNOWN and no further close is sent.
expected: An answer the exchange documents as 'not executed' lets the system know the close did not happen and reduce risk again.
actual: The answer is polled like a lost reply; found=False marks the attempt UNKNOWN, nothing more is sent in that process, SAFE_MODE and one alert; the position stays open until the owner acts.
impact: Unprotected position with no automatic exit in the conditions (fast move, overload) in which -4131 and 503 are expected. Size depends on restart/reconcile behaviour not traced in this lane.
evidence: probe_classify.out: -4131/-4118/-2023/-2025/-4045 -> UNKNOWN_EXCHANGE_ERROR on PLACEMENT; f_errors.md:696-698; f_general.md:50-55,72-76 ('100% failure', 'you can resend'); emergency_close.py:182-187 (definitive set), :740-748, :815-819 (found False -> mark_unknown, PENDING), :22-34 module text.
reproduction: AUDIT/tmp/exchange_facts/probe_classify.py for the classification; the hold was read, not driven.
why_tests_miss: Fakes raise a tabled rejection or a generic ambiguous error; no test feeds a documented-but-untabled refusal to the closer.
recommendation: Owner decision: add the documented definitive refusals to the table; decide whether a reduce-only close may be re-sent under a new id after a definitive refusal or N not-found polls.
known_prior: KNOWN in principle: emergency_close.py:32-34 (owner accepts the position may stay open); the trigger set is larger than recorded
